Samuel Achterberg-Osei
Cloud Engineer | Azure Infrastructure and DevOps
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN]

Professional Summary
Cloud and infrastructure engineer with hands-on experience designing Azure infrastructure, building Terraform-based network foundations, delivering deployment pipelines, and operating AKS. Background includes municipal systems administration, Azure migration, PowerShell automation, and Microsoft 365 security baselines.

Core Skills
Azure infrastructure design and operation; Terraform; Azure DevOps Pipelines; AKS operations; Azure networking; Azure VMs and Azure Migrate; Docker; Helm; App Service; Linux and Windows servers; VMware; PowerShell; Microsoft 365 and Entra ID; Terratest; Python scripting; Proxmox homelab.

Experience
Cloud Engineer (Contract) | Havenstad Logistics | 2025–Present
• Designed and built a Terraform hub-spoke network across three subscriptions, including Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints for storage and SQL, and VNet peering.
• Added Terratest module tests to the Azure DevOps pipeline and a nightly drift-detection job.
• Replaced manual deployments for 15 internal .NET and Node apps with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for build, test, and deployment to App Service or AKS.
• Increased deployment frequency from roughly monthly to several times per week for most apps.
• Operate AKS, managing upgrades, node pools, and ingress; application manifests are owned by developers.

Professional Development | Feb 2024–Feb 2025
• Built a Proxmox homelab and studied Terraform; passed the Terraform Associate certification in 2025.
• Completed a three-month, part-time, online English-language cloud bootcamp in December 2024.

Freelance IT Consultant | 2022–2023
• Created a repeatable PowerShell script and checklist for small-business Microsoft 365 security baselines, covering MFA, Conditional Access, mailbox auditing, and backups.

Career Break | Mar 2020–Aug 2022
• Took a career break for full-time family caregiving; maintained Azure Administrator Associate knowledge and provided unpaid IT support to church and family.

Systems Administrator | Maasbrug Gemeente IT Services | 2014–2020
• Supported approximately 250 Windows and Linux servers across municipal services.
• Led the migration of 60 servers from VMware to Azure IaaS using Azure Migrate; completed cutover over six weekends with no unplanned downtime.
• Used PowerShell for systems administration and automation.

Certifications and Training
Azure Administrator Associate
Terraform Associate, 2025
Three-month online cloud bootcamp, completed December 2024
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity engagement. My experience designing Azure infrastructure, building Terraform-based networking, and delivering deployment pipelines is relevant to the work of taking the infrastructure behind Corvale’s new train fleet from design towards production.

At Havenstad Logistics, I designed and built a Terraform hub-spoke network across three subscriptions, with Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints for storage and SQL, and VNet peering. I added Terratest module tests and nightly drift detection. I also replaced manual deployments for 15 internal .NET and Node apps with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines targeting App Service or AKS, increasing deployment frequency from roughly monthly to several times per week for most apps. I operate AKS, including upgrades, node pools, and ingress, while application manifests remain developer-owned.

Earlier, at Maasbrug Gemeente IT Services, I led the migration of 60 servers from VMware to Azure IaaS. We completed the cutover over six weekends with no unplanned downtime. My experience also includes PowerShell automation and repeatable Microsoft 365 security baselines. My cloud experience is Azure-focused, and I hold the Azure Administrator Associate and Terraform Associate certifications.

Corvale’s work connecting onboard train systems to cloud services is a compelling application of cloud infrastructure and networking. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my Azure, Terraform, and platform operations experience could contribute to the engagement.

Kind regards,
Samuel Achterberg-Osei
